note: Dated log of hotel stay captures (rates are a log, never a single value). Each entry is a snapshot with its rate timestamp and the official source it was read from. The Venetian hotel terms confirm it from the hotel side: 'Daily rates do not include the applicable Clark County Room Tax of 13.38%' (read 2026-11-19).
